BEFORE YOU BEGIN

A few good
questions.

Is this suitable for complete beginners?

Yes. The guide introduces the methods, tools, prompts, and planning steps. You’ll need time to learn, research an audience, and refine your work. A Claude account and a computer are useful starting points.

What exactly do I receive?

A 58-page PDF containing the four core income methods, an expanded subscription chapter, 50 bonus prompts, a marketplace cheat sheet, printable tracker tables, and the 30-day action plan. The resources are inside the PDF; the tracker is not a separate automated spreadsheet.

Why do the sample pages mention $10K/month?

The PDF’s internal title is “How I Would Make $10K/Month With Claude AI in 2026.” It is sold here as the Claude AI Income Blueprint. Income figures are goals and illustrative examples, not earnings guarantees or typical results.

Does the purchase include a Claude subscription?

No. You’re buying an educational ebook. Claude and any other tools are separate. Check current pricing and availability with each provider before choosing a paid tool.

Is this a one-time payment?

Yes. The ebook costs $29.99 USD as a one-time purchase. The subscription chapter teaches you how to plan your own recurring offer; buying the ebook does not enroll you in a subscription.

How do I get it and read it?

Complete your purchase on Gumroad to access the PDF download. You can read it in a PDF reader on your phone, tablet, or computer.

Can I see more before buying?

You can open and enlarge the six actual sample pages above. They include prompts, the action plan, marketplace guide, and tracker.
